title: List the full names of members who are from Illinois and attended the event
question: List the full names of members who are from Illinois and attended the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
FROM member AS m
JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.XCL_041 = z.XCL_043
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
JOIN event AS e ON a.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
WHERE z.XCL_047 = 'Illinois'
  AND b.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement'
  AND b.XCL_005 = (
    SELECT MAX(b2.XCL_005)
    FROM budget AS b2
    WHERE b2.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement'
  )
